queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(TrackCount * 1.0) AS AvgCount FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.TrackCount, c.TrackCount * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.AvgCount, 0) AS RatioToAverage FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_c a ORDER BY (c.TrackCount * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.AvgCount, 0)) IS NULL, RatioToAverage DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over all playlists in the Playlist table, so playlists with no tracks count as 0 tracks. Ties at the cutoff are broken arbitrarily.
The ratio is NULL only if the average is 0, because of the NULLIF guard. Those rows sort last.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is taken only over playlists that have at least one track, so empty playlists are excluded from the average. The ratios change but the ranking does not.

assumptions.assumption: The average tracks per playlist is taken over every row in Playlist, so playlists with no tracks count as 0 and pull the average down.
The ratio is computed in floating point without rounding. It is NULL only if the average is 0, and NULLs sort last. Ties are broken by PlaylistId.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is taken only over playlists that have at least one track, so empty playlists are excluded from the average.
